value.rationale: The criterion is the physically motivated total stationary position variance of second-order stochastic consensus. For the entire natural infinite family of uniform paths and arbitrary \(k\ge2\), an exact all-optima classification and efficient constructive allocation replace combinatorial search, with a sharp instrumentation-support threshold \(n\le3k-2\) and a nontrivial continuum spacing ratio \(15^{1/3}\). The fact is structurally useful and not merely a finite exercise.
